rule.formula: mean over H/V x 2 seeds of (J / .01 + .10 * mean_axis_correction_TV_per_s)
rule.J: arithmetic mean of three time-weighted axis RMSE, m/s
rule.eligibility: four accepted complete runs, independent replay, paired development risk
